clusters.summary: MergeSamplesReadFromSubquery adds the child's scalar SamplesRead but skips the per-step merge whenever either side's slice is nil, so the sum invariant could break silently; no asymmetric call could be constructed
clusters.rationale: The cluster itself concedes no asymmetric call can be constructed; parent and child are both built from the same EnablePerStepStats flag, so the slices are either both nil or both allocated.

clusters.summary: IncrementSamplesReadAtStep guards only i < len while its timestamp twin also checks i >= 0, so a negative step index would panic instead of being ignored
clusters.rationale: IncrementSamplesReadAtStep checks only i < len while IncrementSamplesReadAtTimestamp at line 364 also checks i >= 0; the asymmetry is real and cheap to fix, though no current caller passes a negative index.
